title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 29: the covenant in the land of Moab and the warning against turning to other gods.

questions.text: In which land did Yahweh command Moses to make this covenant with the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says these are the words of the covenant Yahweh commanded Moses to make in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant made in Horeb.

questions.text: What does Moses say did not grow old during the forty years in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Moses says he led them forty years in the wilderness, and their clothes and their sandals did not grow old.

questions.text: Who was Og, according to Moses?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out to battle and were struck.

questions.text: To whom was the land of Sihon and Og given as an inheritance?
questions.explanation: Their land was given as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of the Manassites.

answers.text: The tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Simeon and Levi
The Reubenites, Gadites and half-tribe of the Manassites
The tribes of Ephraim, Dan, Asher and Naphtali
The tribes of Issachar and Zebulun and the Levites

questions.text: How does Moses describe the foreigners who stand before Yahweh with Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 mentions the foreigners in the camps, "from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water."

answers.text: From the one who guards the gate to the one who keeps the sheep
From the one who bakes your bread to the one who builds your houses
From the one who sows your field to the one who reaps your harvest
From the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water

questions.text: Moses warns that there should not be among them a root that produces what?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 warns against anyone turning away to other gods, and against "a root that produces bitter poison."

questions.text: What will Yahweh do to the name of the man who blesses himself in his heart and walks in stubbornness?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will not pardon him; all the curse in this book will fall on him and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.

answers.text: Blot it out from under the sky
Change it to a new name
Make it great among the nations

questions.text: The ruined land is compared to the overthrow of which cities?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says the land will be sulfur, salt and burning, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim.

questions.text: When the nations ask why Yahweh has done this to the land, what answer will be given?
questions.explanation: Men will say it is because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served other gods.

answers.text: They abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers
They failed to pay tribute to their enemies
Their king made a treaty with Egypt
They did not build walls around their cities

questions.text: To whom do the secret things belong?
questions.explanation: Verse 29 says the secret things belong to Yahweh our God, but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever.
